svg-slides

Slide designs with slot markers, in 13 theme sets. Every set ships the same six slide designs with the same slot names, so one payload re-themes with --set. Each card is the design composed with its sample payload by bin/compose-slide.js. Real output bakes colours to hex for one theme; here the slide stays token-driven so you can preview both palettes. Graphic slots hold svg-library components.

Lab --set lab

The original hand-drawn science set: rounded cards with misregistered-print offset copies, teal and amber on white or slate, DNA helix, molecule and orbit motifs. Palette and fonts are the svg-bake.js THEMES defaults, so this file sets none. Slot tables: README.md.

Dark Academia --set academia

Dark Academia: warm near-black brown with antique-gold titles in italic Georgia, parchment-coloured body text, a double inset border frame (a heavy outer and a hairline inner rule), centred wide-tracked titles, thin gold rules and Courier New footnote captions. The light theme is the print inverse: parchment paper, deep-brown text, the same gold accents. Not any template's brand. Slot tables: sets/academia/README.md.

Boardroom --set boardroom

Generic consulting style: navy plus one bright accent per slide, serif titles over sans body, one-sentence titles under a thin rule, a six-square agenda tracker, chart-left / insight-right 60:40 content, "so what" box. Not any firm's template or brand. Slot tables: sets/boardroom/README.md.

Bold geometric --set bold

Saturated colour fields and flat polygon blocks (violet, amber, coral, blue, green) with heavy display type (Arial Black) over a clean grotesque body; high contrast, no gradients, shapes kept clear of every text slot. Slot tables: sets/bold/README.md.

Neo-brutalism --set brutalist

Neo-brutalist style: a high-saturation acid field (lime, hot pink, yellow), white cards, pure black text, 3 to 4 px black borders on every element, hard bottom-right offset shadows drawn as flat offset shapes (no blur), oversized Arial Black headlines over Courier New mono, bold asymmetric blocks with small tilts kept off the text slots. Dark theme: a near-black #0D0D0D field, white text, borders flip to white so they stay visible, hard shadows become solid acid-lime offsets. Not any template's brand. Slot tables: sets/brutalist/README.md.

Cyberpunk HUD --set cyberpunk

Cyberpunk HUD outline style: near-black field with a faint 6 percent cyan grid, outline-only Arial Black titles (transparent fill, 1.5 px cyan stroke), four L-shaped corner brackets on every slide, chamfered panels, Courier New data labels, neon cyan with one magenta second accent. The light theme is a white paper HUD: near-black text, cyan and magenta accents, an 8 percent black grid. Not any template's brand. Slot tables: sets/cyberpunk/README.md.

Art Deco --set deco

Art Deco luxe: cream paper (near-black in the dark theme), metallic gold and a deeper gold as the only two accents, jet-black / cream text, wide-tracked Georgia titles, thin double rules, stepped chevron collars, corner sunburst rays and fan (concentric arc) motifs, very restrained. Not any template's brand. Slot tables: sets/deco/README.md.

Editorial --set editorial

Magazine look: cream paper, deep-brown serif headlines over a clean sans body, one terracotta accent, cool blue for figures, hairline and double rules, an asymmetric grid with a pull-quote and an oversized chapter numeral. Slot tables: sets/editorial/README.md.

Glassmorphism --set glass

Glassmorphism: a deep indigo field with violet, blue and cyan glow blobs built from stacked translucent circles (the designs forbid gradient defs and filters, so the soft edge is a banded approximation), frosted glass cards (translucent white fill, thin light border, rounded corners) holding thin-weight white text in a light Segoe UI-style head over a sans body, cyan and violet accents. The light theme is light glass on a pale sky field with dark text. Not any template's brand. Slot tables: sets/glass/README.md.

Gradient Mesh --set mesh

Gradient-mesh style: a painterly field of overlapping glowing blobs (hot pink, violet, cyan, warm orange) made of stacked translucent circles (gradient defs are not allowed in designs, so the soft edges are banded), white Arial Black display type with a knockout halo in the surface colour, an Arial body. The light theme is a pale pastel field with the same blobs and dark text. Not any template's brand. Slot tables: sets/mesh/README.md.

Nordic Organic --set nordic

Nordic organic minimal: warm cream (deep warm charcoal in the dark theme), dark warm-brown Georgia display type at regular weight over a light Arial body, large low-opacity organic blob shapes as texture (pre-computed paths, no filters), three small brown dots as the only accent, at least 40 percent whitespace, a thin bottom rule with a wide-tracked Courier New caption. Not any template's brand. Slot tables: sets/nordic/README.md.

Swiss --set swiss

International Typographic Style: a strict 12-column grid, one grotesque (Helvetica / Arial) in two weights, flush-left ragged-right type, white content slides framed by bold red colour-block title, statement and closing slides, black rules, no ornament. Slot tables: sets/swiss/README.md.

Terminal --set terminal

Dev-console style: near-black field with a faint 6 percent green grid, code-block panels with a 3 px accent bar on the left, prompt-style ($ and >) eyebrows, a scanline band, Courier New throughout in bright phosphor green with one cyan-blue second accent. The light theme is a paper console: off-white, near-black text, green kept for accents only. Flat geometry only. Not any template's brand. Slot tables: sets/terminal/README.md.
